Basic text-to-speech generation

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")

result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_speech_async(client, "{\"input\":\"Hello, world!\",\"model\":\"tts-1\",\"voice\":\"alloy\"}")
```
